fields.name: Bathcape - Riverside
fields.description: This bath cape is ideal after bathing or swimming. This bath cape is printed in the super cute Riverside print full of bunnies, ducks and riverside plants. The hood covers the head so no heat is lost. Comfy! The inside has an Ivory colour, is mild for the delicate baby skin and absorbs moisture well, so you can dry off the baby in no time. The inside is made of soft terry. After use, easily hang the cape on the loop. You can iron this product but better that you don't. Uncoated fabric absorbs more moisture in a better way.
